reviews.review_title: Review at Paradise Rooftop Restaurant & Bistro
reviews.review_text:
Алина П
9 contributions
1
Simple but delicious daily breakfasts on the roof with a wonderful view of the lake
Sep 2026 • Solo
Beautiful views from the roof onto the lake. Simple, but tasty and hearty food in places, wonderful, English-speaking staff always ready to help and very welcoming to everyone. Thank you for the wonderful breakfasts!
It's a shame I found out too late that besides the buffet with vegetables, fruits, rice, noodles, eggs, and various cooked meats, you can also order eggs in different forms (omelet, fried eggs, etc.) and FO soup... The soup seemed a little lightened for European taste since even in Moscow I ate a spicier version 😅

The only menu where you can order dishes for money to the room during the day until 2:00 PM and in the evening from 5:00 PM until morning. It seemed a little limited in choice to me. And in my opinion, there is too much fast food in it: tacos, pizza, burgers - although I might be wrong about those. There are two types of salads, noodles and rice with vegetables and meat. 
There is alcohol, but it is not relevant to me.
